verses.restored: YHWH reigns; let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake.

familiar.text: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

modern.text: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: YHWH is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

familiar.text: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

modern.text: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.

original.text: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל הָֽעַמִּֽים

verses.restored: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

familiar.text: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

modern.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!

original.text: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא

verses.restored: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

familiar.text: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

modern.text: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.

original.text: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ

verses.restored: Exalt ye YHWH our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

familiar.text: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

modern.text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!

original.text: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא

verses.restored: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon YHWH, and he answered them.

familiar.text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

modern.text: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.

original.text: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם

verses.restored: He spake to them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

familiar.text: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

modern.text: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.

original.text: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן לָֽמוֹ

verses.restored: Thou answeredst them, O YHWH our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

familiar.text: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

modern.text: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל עֲלִילוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Exalt YHWH our God, and worship at his holy hill; for YHWH our God is holy.

familiar.text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

modern.text: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
